explanation: Single body in free fall (no walls/contacts, controller off) gains energy in one dt=1/30 step. Gravity should change vy by -g*dt=-1 m/s (60->61), but vy becomes ~-66 and drop is ~2.1m, inflating KE+PE from 2145J to ~2460J, exceeding 10%+5J tolerance. The step used 71 fast-motion substeps, indicating the substepped semi-implicit Euler over-applies gravity per substep (energy pump proportional to substep count), creating energy from nothing.
